sample: 48 train and 32 valid row groups chosen uniformly without replacement, excluding every reconstructable possibly inspected feature row group; all previously census-exposed targets acknowledged
validation_rows: need_prediction AND is_scored AND step>=611; extra 512-row burn-in applied equally to all models
feature_policy: 112 current features; instantaneous i0 price increments; feature-only causal EMAs; log dwell and row-clock event rate; no target-derived scale, steps, filtering or mask input
fixed_ridge: train-only mean/std; |clipped target|-weighted ridge; lambda=0.001*sum(weights); unpenalized intercept; no tuning
memory: all 22 i0 price-feature increments, event-clock or row-clock exponential smoothing at half-lives 4,16,64
matched_control: same current/instant/clock features plus same 66 event-memory features delayed by 512 rows within the same sequence; no wrap or future data

hypotheses.claim: Recent event-clock memory adds specific predictive information beyond current state, instantaneous changes, activity and stale history
hypotheses.success: event_memory global sampled WP exceeds both current_instant_clock and delayed_event_memory by >=0.005; paired sequence bootstrap lower 95% bounds exceed zero
hypotheses.rejection: either gain <=0; intermediate results inconclusive; row_memory comparison distinguishes event clock from generic smoothing
hypotheses.caveat: proxy ridge only, no strong-baseline or campaign-independent evidence

hypotheses.claim: Pooled wait overdispersion includes dwell-age dependence surviving exact price-state and recent activity matching
hypotheses.procedure: valid feature-only next-price-state event labels on steps 611..19998; compare age 1..3 against 8..31 within sequence/exact 22-price-state/current event-rate bucket, >=10 rows per arm; harmonic support weights; delayed age control
hypotheses.success: absolute matched hazard difference >=0.02 and paired sequence bootstrap excludes zero
hypotheses.rejection: conditional difference negligible or insufficient overlap; do not infer semi-Markov behavior from pooled CV alone

uncertainty: 400 paired sequence bootstrap replicates, seed 610104; rows are not independent; campaign connected-component identities unavailable
